label: education
text: A mutual fund pools money from many investors to buy stocks and bonds. A professional manager handles the portfolio. This is educational content, not investment advice.

label: education
text: SIP stands for Systematic Investment Plan. You invest a fixed amount every month, which averages out your purchase cost over time. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

label: education
text: Equity funds have delivered around 12% annualised returns over very long periods, but yearly returns swing widely and capital is at risk. Never invest money you may need next month. Educational purposes only.

label: education
text: An emergency fund should cover 3 to 6 months of expenses in a savings account or liquid fund. It is not an investment; it is protection against job loss or medical bills.

label: education
text: Diversification means spreading money across asset types so one bad performer cannot sink you. A mix of equity, debt, and gold behaves very differently from a single stock. Do your own research.

label: education
text: Options buyers pay a premium for the right to buy or sell later, and most weekly options expire worthless. Studies show a large majority of individual traders lose money in derivatives. Not investment advice.

label: education
text: Compounding means your returns also earn returns. Starting a small SIP at 25 beats starting a large one at 40, because time matters more than timing. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks.

label: education
text: Term insurance pays your family if you die during the policy term; it has no maturity value. Buy cover of 10 to 15 times your annual income and disclose health conditions honestly.

label: education
text: Some traders show profit screenshots, but screenshots prove nothing about future results and can be faked. Judge any strategy by its audited record and disclosed risks, not by pictures.

label: education
text: A credit card charges 36 to 42% annual interest if you revolve the balance. Paying only the minimum due is one of the fastest ways to fall into a debt trap.

label: education
text: Index funds simply copy a market index like the Nifty 50 and charge very low fees. They will never beat the index, but most active funds fail to beat it either over long periods.

label: education
text: PPF currently pays around 7.1% tax-free interest with a 15-year lock-in. It suits conservative long-term goals, not emergencies, since withdrawals are restricted.

label: education
text: Profit booking is not a crime, but frequent trading raises brokerage, taxes, and mistakes. Check your portfolio quarterly, not every hour. For education only.

label: education
text: A stock hitting an upper circuit only means buyers exceeded sellers that day. Circuits protect the market from panic; they say nothing about whether the company is worth buying.

label: education
text: Crypto assets can rise or crash 20% in a day and attract 30% tax plus surcharge on gains in India, with no loss set-off. Treat them as high-risk speculation, not savings.

label: education
text: NPS invests your retirement money across equity and debt with very low costs. Returns are market-linked, withdrawals have rules, and annuities are compulsory at maturity.

label: education
text: Before trusting any adviser, search their name on SEBI's official Investment Adviser list. Registration numbers can be faked in videos, so always verify on the official site.

label: education
text: An IPO lists with hype, but listing gains are never certain and many IPOs fall below issue price within a year. Read the prospectus risk section before applying.

label: education
text: Gold has preserved purchasing power across centuries, yet it can stay flat for a decade. Sovereign gold bonds and ETFs avoid making charges that physical jewellery carries.

label: education
text: Stop-loss orders limit damage by exiting a trade at a preset price, but they cannot prevent losses in a gap-down opening. Position sizing matters more than any single indicator.

label: education
text: म्यूचुअल फंड कई निवेशकों का पैसा इकट्ठा करके शेयर और बॉन्ड में लगाता है। फंड का प्रबंधन पेशेवर मैनेजर करता है। यह केवल शैक्षणिक जानकारी है, निवेश सलाह नहीं।

label: education
text: एसआईपी यानी हर महीने एक तय रकम निवेश करना। इससे बाजार के उतार-चढ़ाव की औसत कीमत मिलती है। पिछले प्रदर्शन से भविष्य के रिटर्न की गारंटी नहीं मिलती।

label: education
text: लंबी अवधि में इक्विटी फंड ने औसतन दोहरे अंक का रिटर्न दिया है, लेकिन हर साल रिटर्न बदलता है और पूंजी पर जोखिम रहता है। वही पैसा लगाएं जिसकी तुरंत जरूरत न हो।

label: education
text: आपातकालीन फंड में 3 से 6 महीने का खर्च बचत खाते में रखें। यह निवेश नहीं, नौकरी जाने या बीमारी जैसी स्थिति से बचाव है।

label: education
text: ऑप्शन खरीदने वाला प्रीमियम देता है और ज्यादातर साप्ताहिक ऑप्शन बेकार समाप्त होते हैं। डेरिवेटिव में ज्यादातर छोटे व्यापारी पैसा गंवाते हैं। यह निवेश सलाह नहीं है।

label: education
text: चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज का मतलब है कि आपके मुनाफे पर भी मुनाफा बनता है। 25 की उम्र में छोटी एसआईपी 40 की उम्र की बड़ी एसआईपी से बेहतर साबित हो सकती है।

label: education
text: टर्म इंश्योरेंस में पॉलिसी अवधि में मृत्यु पर परिवार को रकम मिलती है, मैच्योरिटी पर कुछ नहीं। अपनी सालाना आय का 10 से 15 गुना कवर लें और सेहत की सही जानकारी दें।

label: education
text: क्रेडिट कार्ड पर बकाया रखने पर सालाना 36 से 42 प्रतिशत ब्याज लगता है। सिर्फ न्यूनतम रकम चुकाना कर्ज के जाल में फंसने का तेज तरीका है।

label: education
text: किसी भी सलाहकार पर भरोसा करने से पहले सेबी की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर उसका पंजीकरण जांचें। वीडियो में दिखाया गया नंबर नकली भी हो सकता है।

label: education
text: पीपीएफ में अभी लगभग 7.1 प्रतिशत कर-मुक्त ब्याज मिलता है और 15 साल का लॉक-इन होता है। यह लंबी अवधि के सुरक्षित लक्ष्य के लिए है, आपातकाल के लिए नहीं।

label: education
text: सोना सदियों से संपत्ति बचाता आया है, फिर भी दशक भर स्थिर रह सकता है। गहनों पर लगने वाले बनाने के शुल्क से बचने के लिए बॉन्ड या ईटीएफ बेहतर विकल्प हैं।

label: education
text: आईपीओ में लिस्टिंग पर मुनाफा पक्का नहीं होता, कई आईपीओ एक साल में निर्गम मूल्य से नीचे चले जाते हैं। आवेदन से पहले जोखिम वाले खंड को जरूर पढ़ें।

label: education
text: Mutual fund matlab sabka paisa ek jagah pool karke stocks aur bonds me lagana. Manager professional hota hai. Ye sirf education hai, investment advice nahi.

label: education
text: SIP me har mahine fixed amount jata hai, isliye market up-down ka average price milta hai. Past performance future returns ki guarantee nahi deta.

label: education
text: Equity funds ne long term me acche returns diye hain, lekin har saal number alag hota hai aur capital par risk rehta hai. Wahi paisa lagao jiski urgent zarurat na ho.

label: education
text: Emergency fund me 3 se 6 mahine ka kharcha saving account me rakho. Ye investment nahi hai, job loss ya medical emergency se bachav hai.

label: education
text: Option buyer premium deta hai aur most weekly options zero ho jate hain. Derivatives me majority retail traders loss karte hain. Ye advice nahi, sirf jankari hai.

label: education
text: Compounding ka matlab profit par bhi profit. 25 ki umar me chhoti SIP 40 ki umar ki badi SIP se aage nikal sakti hai, kyunki time sabse bada factor hai.

label: education
text: Term insurance me policy period me death par family ko amount milta hai, maturity par kuch nahi. Annual income ka 10 se 15 guna cover lo.

label: education
text: Profit screenshots se kuch prove nahi hota, ye fake bhi ho sakte hain. Kisi bhi strategy ko uske audited record aur disclosed risk se judge karo.

label: education
text: Credit card ka balance aage badhane par 36 se 42 percent annual interest lagta hai. Sirf minimum due chukana debt trap ka shortcut hai.

label: education
text: Kisi adviser par bharosa karne se pehle SEBI ki official site par uska registration check karo. Video me dikhaya number fake bhi ho sakta hai.

label: education
text: Index fund Nifty 50 ko copy karta hai aur fees bahut kam leta hai. Ye index ko beat nahi karega, lekin long term me most active funds bhi beat nahi kar pate.

label: education
text: Crypto ek din me 20 percent upar ya neeche ho sakta hai, aur India me gains par 30 percent tax lagta hai bina loss set-off ke. Ise speculation samjho, savings nahi.
